question: Lymph is a light clear fluid made up of white blood cells that attack harmful _______ in the blood.
solution:
The correct answer is __**bacteria**__.

__
 
• **Lymph is a light clear fluid made up of white blood cells that attack harmful bacteria in the blood**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lymph Circulatory System**

 
 
• The** light yellow fluid **found in the intercellular spaces between different tissues and cells is called lymph.
 
• The corpuscles found in the lymph are called **lymphocytes**.
 
• Lymph flows only in one direction from the **tissue towards the heart**.
 
• **Functions of Lymph**
 
 
• Lymph forms the lymphocytes.
 
• The lymphocytes present in lymph help prevent the body from disease by killing the **harmful bacteria.**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diseases caused by bacteria:**

 
 
• Diphtheria, pneumonia, cholera, tetanus, tuberculosis, plague, and gonorrhea.
 
 
 
• **Diseases caused by fungi:**
 
 
• Ringworm and athlete's foot.
 
 
 
• **Diseases caused by protozoa:**
 
 
• Malaria, Dysentery, Diarrhea, Kala Azari.
